text: Offers dozens of prebuilt connectors for shopping carts, billing systems, ERPs, and accounting platforms that sync transactions automatically
quote: Dozens of prebuilt connectors cover shopping carts, billing systems, ERPs, and accounting platforms. Pick your platform, authorize it once, and Kintsugi keeps transactions in sync from then on.

text: Provides a REST API and official SDKs for building custom integrations
quote: Build against the REST API or an official SDK. Start with Planning an Integration to choose your integration level, then Syncing Transaction Records for the payload shape.

text: Determines nexus by analyzing transactions from the prior full calendar year through today to find when a filing obligation began
quote: Send transactions covering the previous full calendar year through today. Kintsugi determines nexus by looking back across that window, so without it we cannot tell you when you crossed a threshold or when your filing obligation began.

text: Collects business presence info (offices, employees, inventory) to assess physical nexus exposure
quote: Tell Kintsugi where you have: Offices, stores, or warehouses, Employees or contractors, including remote staff working from home, Inventory held for sale...

text: API keys can be created with configurable expiration windows (never, 1 month, 6 months, 1 year)
quote: Choose when the key should expire: Never, One Month, Six Month, or One Year.

text: Provides an MCP server giving AI assistants direct access to Kintsugi's API documentation for building integrations
quote: Kintsugi's MCP server gives AI assistants direct access to our API documentation, making it easier for developers to build integrations with accurate, up-to-date code examples.

text: Offers a defined migration path for switching from another tax provider, reduced to mapping a handful of concerns
quote: Migrating tax providers is mostly a mapping exercise plus one judgment call. The mapping is small: four concerns, four replacements.

text: Classifies every product into a category and subcategory that determines how it's taxed across jurisdictions
quote: Kintsugi classifies every product into a category and subcategory, which together determine how it is taxed across jurisdictions.

text: Tax estimate API endpoint prices sales tax before payment is taken, suitable for checkout flows
quote: The tax estimate endpoint (POST /v1/tax/estimate) prices sales tax before you take payment.

text: Publishes five official SDKs (Python, TypeScript, Java, PHP, Ruby) generated from the same OpenAPI spec
quote: Five official SDKs. Python, TypeScript, Java, PHP and Ruby, each published to its language's package registry and generated from the same OpenAPI spec that produces this API reference.

text: API endpoint returns a list of all nexuses for the organization
quote: Get a list of all nexuses for the organization.

text: Create Registration API lets users create and track tax registrations across multiple jurisdictions
quote: The Create Registration API allows users to create a new registration for tracking and managing tax filings efficiently across multiple jurisdictions.

text: Get Filings API retrieves a paginated list of filings filterable by date, jurisdiction, country, and status
quote: The Get Filings API retrieves a paginated list of filings based on filters such as dates, jurisdiction, Country, status, etc.

text: Create Exemption API lets developers create exemption records with type, jurisdiction, and validity dates
quote: The Create Exemption API allows you to create a new exemption record. This includes defining details such as exemption type, jurisdiction, Country, State, validity dates, etc.

text: Finds unknown tax exposure, registers the business, and files returns everywhere it sells, backed by human support
quote: Kintsugi finds the exposure you didn’t know you had, registers you, and files everywhere you sell with real people to support you whenever needed.
